welcome.title: This is your chat screen
welcome.body: Everything starts here — chat with your team's models, or head into Control Hub to finish setting up your workspace. Let's walk through the essentials, about 2 minutes.

controlHub.title: Head into Control Hub
controlHub.body: Click your name in the bottom-left corner, then select Control Hub. It's where you'll connect AI models, add departments, invite your team and set up sign-in.

apiKey.title: Add your first API key
apiKey.body: Click here to connect a provider like OpenAI or Anthropic. Paste in the key you generated from their dashboard — we encrypt it at rest.

invite.title: Invite Users
invite.body: Add people by email to bring them into your workspace. This is optional — skip it if you're exploring solo for now.

signIn.title: Choose how your team signs in
signIn.body: By default, the Grengin proxy handles sign-in for you — nothing to set up. If you'd rather use your own OAuth app, switch here and add your client ID and secret.

prompt.title: Send your first prompt
prompt.body: Type anything here — a question, a task, a document to summarize and hit send. Your workspace is set up — this is the last step.

guide.label: Setup guide
guide.title: Finish setting up
guide.twoLeft: 2 quick things, then you're all set.
guide.oneLeft: 1 quick thing left, then you're all set.
